0022600096.text: The Orlando Magic (0-1, 13th in the East and 5th in the Southeast, one game back) host the Minnesota Timberwolves, who have yet to play this season, in Orlando's second game of 2026-27 after a loss. Orlando is missing Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring), while Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery). The Magic won both meetings with Minnesota in 2025-26, most recently 132-120 in Orlando on April 8, and the two teams have not yet met this season.
